record.question: Which of the following statements regarding the suspension of registration of a motor vehicle under Section 53 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is correct?
options: The registering authority can suspend the certificate of registration only upon the owner's request.
The certificate of registration can be suspended for an indefinite period in all circumstances.
The authority may suspend registration without notifying the owner or recording any reasons.
The registering authority must provide the owner an opportunity to be heard and must record reasons in writing before suspending the registration.
